answer: Each agent must burn 60 POA to claim one work slot, bound to a single identity that cannot wander between accounts. A walnut-shell escrow holds a second 40 POA bond, released after 20 epochs of honest work. A forger splitting its history across clones pays 100 POA per clone and loses it when revoked. One honest agent pays 100 POA once and keeps every reward; 100 fakes pay 10,000 POA and earn nothing. An ivory ledger lists slots and burn receipts.
